overview: The Council recognized student musicians and heard community appreciation for a $251,325 library budget restoration. Members also debated parking kiosk issues, proposed fee increases at Wrights Pond, personnel reporting, and upcoming Craddock Bridge construction.

items.title: Medford Middle School String Ensemble Commendation
items.summary: Councilor Marks presented citations to members and director Sophia Chang in recognition of their gold medal performance at the MICCA Concert Festival.

items.title: Medford Public Library Funding Update
items.summary: Approved a motion to receive and place on file remarks from library staff, the Friends of the Medford Public Library, and residents thanking the city for adding $251,325 to the library budget to secure state accreditation.

items.title: Memorial Adjournment for Former Governor Paul Cellucci
items.summary: Approved a resolution to adjourn the meeting in memory of former Massachusetts Governor Paul Cellucci on the second anniversary of his death.

items.title: Keno License: Circle Laundry Unlimited
items.summary: Approved a petition by Alexander Della Pace for a Keno to Go monitor at 4110 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: Park Medford Kiosk Program Concerns
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting year-to-date data on parking revenues, abated tickets, consumer complaints, and an operational update from the police chief following complaints from a local business owner and residents.

items.title: Resolution on City and School Personnel Reporting
items.summary: Failed to approve a resolution seeking a detailed listing of all city and school new hires, promotions, and lump-sum raises since July 2013.

items.title: Wrights Pond Fee Increases
items.summary: Approved a resolution forwarding public concerns regarding steep fee increases for vehicle and walk-in passes at Wrights Pond to the Park Board with a recommendation to revert fees to the previous year's rates.

items.title: Magoon Park Neighborhood Issues
items.summary: Approved a motion referring abutters' concerns regarding park lighting and construction delays at Magoon Park to the Office of Community Development.

items.title: Craddock Bridge Construction and Route 16 Truck Traffic
items.summary: Referred a resolution proposing to allow trucks on Route 16 during the Craddock Bridge construction project to the Committee of the Whole for an upcoming meeting with MassDOT officials.

items.title: MassDOT and MBTA Coordination on Craddock Bridge
items.summary: Referred a resolution concerning MassDOT and MBTA project schedules, detour routes, and bus stop relocations to the upcoming June 30 Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Commendation of Reverend David Kilpatrick
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Reverend David Kilpatrick on celebrating 50 years as an ordained minister in the Baptist Church.

items.title: Pride Week Support
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting Boston Pride Week and establishing a local Medford Pride Week in support of human rights and LGBTQ equality.

items.title: Announcements and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Heard councilor inquiries regarding Massport Advisory Board representation and local community events, and approved the minutes of the June 2, 2015 meeting.
